name: samaya-finance-skills
description: Finance research workflows powered by Samaya: build and update financial models, results-day variance tables, earnings recaps, capital allocation reviews and fact checks, with every figure sourced and cited through the Samaya MCP server

interface.longDescription: Finance research workflows for analysts and portfolio managers, running on Samaya's financial research MCP server. Build and roll forward three-statement models, produce results-day variance tables and earnings recaps, fact-check and reconcile figures against their sources, score guidance credibility, track risk factors and company KPIs across filings, map revenue and cost drivers, end-market exposure and correlations, break down M&A deals, and react to price moves and new documents, straight into Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Every figure is pulled from filings, transcripts, guidance and consensus through Samaya and carries a citation back to its source.
defaultPrompt: Build a results-day variance table for a company I cover
Roll my financial model forward for the latest reported quarter
Build the bull and bear case on a stock, then cross-examine both
